description.en: Adversarial Socratic review of a plan or idea against the real code - branches of questions with file:line, locked/open/deferred decisions and a risk register. Changes nothing.
description.ru: Состязательный допрос плана или идеи по реальному коду - ветки вопросов с file:line, решения locked/open/deferred и реестр рисков. Ничего не меняет.

ru: Найди дыры в моём плане перехода на очередь сообщений
Проверь по коду, выдержит ли идея кэширования на уровне API
Устрой допрос плана разбиения монолита, без реализации
Покритикуй мой план релиза по коду и перечисли риски
en: Find the holes in my plan for moving to a message queue
Check against the code whether the API-level caching idea holds up
Interrogate the plan to split the monolith, no implementation
Critique my release plan against the code and list the risks

quality_mode.effect: глубина допроса: quick - shallow (3 ветки), standard - 5, full - deep (8)

nodes.prompt:
Read-only. Branches by depth - shallow: Scope and Boundaries, Data Model and State, Edge Cases and Failure Modes; standard: + Integration and Dependencies, Scale and Performance; deep: + Security and Access Control, Observability and Operations, Migration and Rollback.
One question at a time, 3-5 per branch, at least 2 question-answer pairs per branch; EVERY question cites file:line - a question without it is not a question. Answer each from the code; what the code cannot answer goes to `open`.
Align terms first (check collisions with names in the code). Conflicts of the plan with the code or with a locked decision: priority DEC (locked decision) > RSC (out of scope) > MOD (crosses 2+ top modules); at most 3 conflicts x 3 questions; each ends RESOLVED, DEFERRED or ACCEPTED_RISK, code wins.
Depth reached without a decision - force the synthesis.

Synthesize the Q&A into Locked (confirmed by code), Open (not verified), Deferred (not applicable now) and a risk register (risk, severity, file:line, mitigation). Flag anything the plan assumes that the code contradicts.

input.goal: Add Redis cache in front of the API

test.live: песочница: план с дырой; допрос возвращает риск с file:line
